subject: health
concept: Synthesizing hygiene, nutrition, movement, mental/emotional wellness, safety, health literacy, and public health knowledge into one coherent personal health philosophy
source_inspiration: original content, synthesizing the full K-12 health sequence — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student reviews the major concepts learned across all health grades and identifies which matter most going forward
exercise.abstract: Student writes a personal health philosophy statement drawing on concepts from across the full K-12 sequence

assessment.mastery_threshold: statement genuinely references at least three distinct concepts from across different grade levels
misconception_flags: statement is generic and doesn't reference any specific concept actually learned in the curriculum

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
